requirement: The bootloader shall validate dual-bank A/B firmware partitions with SHA-256 integrity check and automatically roll back to the fallback bank if the boot watchdog timer expires before confirmation.

constraints.description: Manage active and inactive dual-bank partitions (Bank A / Bank B)
Verify cryptographic SHA-256 checksum on firmware payload
Start boot watchdog timer upon staging new partition
Perform automatic fallback rollback on boot timeout
Commit partition on successful boot confirmation call
